hero.title: Privacy Policy
hero.description: At Velocita, we curate more than just vehicles; we curate trust. Learn how we handle your data with the same precision we apply to our editorial marketplace.

sections.title: Introduction
body: Velocita ("we," "our," or "us") is committed to protecting your privacy. This Privacy Policy explains how your personal information is collected, used, and disclosed by Velocita. This Privacy Policy applies to our website, and its associated subdomains.

By accessing or using our Service, you signify that you have read, understood, and agree to our collection, storage, use, and disclosure of your personal information as described in this Privacy Policy and our Terms of Service.

items.label: Security
items.description: We use enterprise-grade encryption to ensure your data stays private and protected from unauthorized access.

items.label: Control
items.description: You own your data. We provide tools for you to export, delete, or modify your information at any time.

sections.title: Data Collection
sections.intro: We collect information from you when you visit our service, register, place an order, subscribe to our newsletter, respond to a survey or fill out a form.

dataCards.title: Identity Data
dataCards.description: Includes name, username, title, and other identifiers provided during registration.

dataCards.title: Contact Data
dataCards.description: Includes billing address, delivery address, email address, and telephone numbers.

dataCards.title: Financial Data
dataCards.description: Includes bank account and payment card details processed through secure gateways.

sections.title: How We Use Your Data
sections.intro: Any of the information we collect from you may be used in one of the following ways:
items: To personalize your experience and better respond to your individual needs.
To improve our service offerings based on the information and feedback we receive from you.
To process transactions swiftly and securely.
To send periodic emails regarding your order or other products and services.
sections.bannerText: Your data is never sold to third-party advertisers. Period.

sections.title: Third Parties
body: We do not sell your personal information. However, we may share your data with trusted affiliates, vendors, and payment processors who help us provide services.
All third-party data processors are contractually bound to implement appropriate data protection measures and may not use your data for any other purpose.

sections.title: Cookies
sections.intro: We use cookies to enhance your browsing experience, serve personalized ads or content, and analyze our traffic. By clicking "Accept All", you consent to our use of cookies.

cookieTable.purpose: Necessary for the site to function and cannot be switched off.
Allow us to count visits and traffic sources for site improvement.
Enable the website to provide enhanced functionality and personalization.

sections.title: Contact Us
body: If you have any questions, feedback, or complaints regarding this Policy or how your personal data is handled, please reach out to us at privacy@velocita.com.
You may also write to our Data Protection Officer (DPO) at our registered office address listed on the Velocita website.
